scope: Read-only review of installed smooth-Vf pair2401/2402 and ST schematics; no hardware change or FOC run

existing_board_measurement_chain.shunts: Three low-side shunts R25/R26/R27, schematic nominal0.04ohm; actual assembly value not established by code
existing_board_measurement_chain.amplifiers: External TSV994 U1A/U1B/U1C with1.65V bias, schematic gain2.1
existing_board_measurement_chain.routing_caveat: Board signal selectors and physical shield routing must match amplified outputs; firmware definitions alone do not establish physical switch positions

existing_software.current_driver: R3_2 initialized, ADC1/ADC2 injected channels with TIM1_TRGO configuration
existing_software.v_mapping: PC1 / ADC1_IN7 or ADC2_IN7, depending on sampling sector
existing_software.internal_comparators: CompOCPA/B/CSelection=MC_NULL; not configured for phase current regulation
existing_software.high_frequency_task: Calls ACIM_VF_Controller, not a closed-loop current controller
existing_software.current_reply_slots: Existing main.c reply byte slots are used for fault diagnostics; cannot silently overwrite them with current samples
existing_software.current_nominal_conversion: At Rshunt0.04ohm and gain2.1,0.084V/A and about9.6mA per12bit ADC count before filtering; not a qualified accuracy specification

Integrate official MCSDK ACIM LSO-FOC current PI loops, flux observer and startup state machine while retaining existing localSTOP,BKIN,watchdogs and no-auto-restart behavior

motor_parameter_evidence: docs/mcsdk_acim_motor_profile.template.json remains unfilled; catalog profile is a V/f candidate, not measured FOC data
recommended_next_stage: Qualify current acquisition first while retaining corrected scalar control; do not switch to FOC solely because comparators are present
physical_status_not_reconfirmed: Last observed DC bus after no-motor run323V; no subsequent off/discharge confirmation. No flash or wiring actions performed.
